result: ⭐ ONE OF THE TWO SERIES SEPARATES THE PROGRAMMES, NOT BOTH — and that is the whole finding, stated at its true weight. GSE24369 (n=35): all six hypoxia panels exceed their own size-matched random null (p_emp 0.0005–0.029); none of the six PPARγ panels do (p_emp 0.11–0.50); the PPARγ knockout-UP CONTROL set sits at the 63rd percentile, where a control belongs. GSE4303 (n=16): the series CANNOT DISCRIMINATE — a random size-matched panel already reaches rho +0.25 to +0.42, so raw rhos of +0.6 carry no information; one hypoxia and one PPARγ panel clear, which is the shape of noise. ⛔ MUST NEVER BE WRITTEN AS A TWO-SERIES REPLICATION.
the_two_controls: ⛔ WITHOUT EITHER, THE ANSWER IS MANUFACTURED. (1) NDRG1 is itself a member of several published hypoxia sets (the Buffa metagene among them), so every panel excludes it — a panel containing the subject correlates with itself and returns a large positive number for any composition. (2) The size-matched null is what produced the one-series verdict; without it the small series reads as a clean second replication. Both are mutation-tested rather than asserted.

a_test_i_wrote_was_wrong_and_the_run_cau: ⚠ RECORDED BECAUSE IT IS THE ARGUMENT FOR EXECUTING MUTATIONS RATHER THAN REASONING ABOUT THEM. The first version of the null's mutation test asserted that a naive raw-rho threshold would flip the SMALL series to 'separating'. It does not — it calls that series non-separating too, for the wrong reason (three PPARγ panels are also high there). The test failed, the numbers were re-derived, and the true statement is stronger: NO single global rho threshold reproduces the committed verdict on both series, because in the small series the PPARγ maximum (+0.771) EXCEEDS the hypoxia minimum (+0.568). Had that assertion been reasoned about instead of run, a false claim about the method would have shipped inside a test that passed.
left_open: Direction and mechanism — a transcript tracking a hypoxia proxy is equally consistent with HIF-driven abundance and with both being downstream of something else, and nothing here separates them. And the subset limitation: each panel is scored on 9–41 members against published sets of 44–231, because the committed artifact carries per-sample values for 479 genes only. Filed as AUT-PROP-051 rather than absorbed.
